summary: Suzano S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings results presentation (Exhibit 99.1), a routine periodic disclosure by the Brazilian pulp and paper issuer. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; the document reports operating metrics — adjusted EBITDA, net debt of US$14.7 billion, leverage near 3.7x excluding Arbex pro forma EBITDA, pulp inventory of 3.2 million tons, and cash cost of R$825/ton. No special-situation mechanics apply; watch only for leverage and pulp pricing trends, not deal arbitrage.
